respuesta.title: What is a commercial action plan?
respuesta.body: It is the work of making the company’s commercial decisions and defining the plan to put them into practice. It starts by understanding what is happening in the business and in the market, and explores growth possibilities: current customers show where the company already found value, but on their own they do not show every growth option.

items.question: Which commercial decisions are made?
items.answer: Seven: growth priority, market, priority customer (ICP), situation and need, value and differentiation, offer and access to market.

items.answer: The company: you make the decisions and execute. The roadmap defines what to change, what comes first, who owns it and what to watch.

items.question: What does the three-month review include?
items.answer: An adoption review and commercial recalibration, included in the service: what was implemented, what changed and what should be adjusted, with recommendations and an updated roadmap.

items.question: Why does it include an AI positioning study?
items.answer: Because buyers already use AI when they buy: according to a Gartner survey of 646 B2B buyers (August–September 2025), 45% used AI tools during a recent purchase. The study reviews how AI finds, describes and evaluates you.

respuesta.title: What is the 2027 Action Plan?
respuesta.body: Having sales targets, a budget and commercial initiatives under way doesn't always mean knowing where to focus the effort. The 2027 Action Plan is a consulting engagement that helps leadership understand its situation, explore growth possibilities and make commercial decisions on solid grounds. Those decisions become recommendations to strengthen the company's commercial model and positioning, together with a roadmap to guide the work of 2027.
